entities.summary: Ibas of Edessa was bishop of Edessa and was born in Syria. His name is the Syriac equivalent of "Donatus". He is frequently associated with the growth of Nestorianism, although this assertion is contentious and has been opposed. Ibas of Edessa was a writers & intellectuals from Syria.
